summary: In the construct, racks of weapons materialize and begin to arm themselves. Trinity remarks that no one has ever done anything like this. Neo answers with a skeptical "Yeah?", then snap-cocks an Uzi and says that is why their plan is going to work.

what_changes.before: He meets Trinity's observation of the unprecedented act with a questioning "Yeah?", as if gauging her reaction.
what_changes.after: He asserts confident certainty that their approach will succeed, snapping an Uzi into readiness.
what_changes.evidence: NEO / Yeah? / He snap-cocks an Uzi. / NEO / That's why it's going to work.

event_hint.one_line: Neo and Trinity arm themselves with a full rack of construct weapons in preparation for their assault.
